core_obligations: Reduce to the map on spaces: the gerbe condition is preserved by base change, so universal bijectivity and openness of the map on points suffice (proof lines 6624-6627)

Surjectivity on points: for an object of the target over a field, the first gerbe clause gives an fppf cover on which the object is isomorphic to the image of an object of the source, and choosing a field-valued point of one piece of the cover produces a lift after a field extension (proof lines 6628-6638)
Injectivity on points: two objects of the source with isomorphic images after an extension become isomorphic after a further extension by the second gerbe clause (proof lines 6639-6643)
Openness: the map is continuous and bijective, and it is open because the morphism is fppf and a flat morphism of finite presentation is open on spaces (proof lines 6644-6647)
proof_roadmap: 由 gerbe 条件对基变换保持，只需证 |X| → |Y| 是拓扑空间的同胚。
满：任给 Spec(k) 上的对象 y，由 (2)(a) 取 fppf 覆盖并挑非空支，取域点即得 y 的拉回来自 X 的对象。
单：x, x' 的像在扩域上同构 ⇒ 由 (2)(b) 存在扩域使 x ≅ x'。
已连续且双射，再证开：f 是 fppf、平坦有限表现 ⇒ 在拓扑空间上开（本章 fppf-open + gerbe-fppf）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a gerbe morphism of algebraic stacks is a universal homeomorphism (author lemma at source lines 6616-6619, label lemma-gerbe-bijection-points). The proof (source lines 6624-6648) reduces to the map on topological spaces by base change, proves surjectivity there from the local existence of objects and injectivity from the local existence of isomorphisms supplied by the gerbe condition, and obtains openness from the facts that the morphism is fppf and that flat morphisms of finite presentation are open (proof lines 6624-6647). The verification of bijectivity on points through the two gerbe clauses and the openness step are the content. H3.
